source.quote: We are raising our revenue outlook by $300 million to a range of $6.6 billion to $6.8 billion.
We are investing in both commercial execution and pipeline advancement with a modest increase in operating expenses to an updated range of $4.8 billion to $5 billion.
We now expect GAAP operating income of $1 billion to $1.1 billion and non-GAAP operating income of $1.7 billion to $1.8 billion.
BRUKINSA sales totaled $893 million, representing growth of 31%, which exceeded expectations due to several underlying factors.
We now expect operating expenses of $4.9 billion-$5 billion, a narrowing of the prior range of $4.8 billion-$5 billion.
We expect GAAP operating income of $1.2 billion-$1.3 billion, an increase of $200 million across the range.
